comparison.objective: Set and lock a gripper stop versus squeeze spring tongs shut, engage their pull-tab lock, and store them.
comparison.physical_skill: Both involve holding a mechanism while engaging a lock, but the candidate requires seated driver-and-wrench countertorque and possible wrench regrasping; the tongs require compression plus linear tab pulling.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires a precise angle retained through repeated actuation; the tongs task requires shut arms, tab engagement, release, and placement inside a tray compartment.
comparison.reason: The shared hold-while-locking primitive is generic; concentric torque-preserving calibration and post-lock cycle verification constitute a different tested ability from spring-tong closure.
